end.summary:
- Identified football as a sphere and a die as a cube.
- Identified a matchbox as a cuboid after checking that its faces are not all equal squares.
- Named a candle as a cylinder and described its two flat faces.
- Stated that a cone has one flat face and a cylinder has two.
- Teach-back was not passed; the matchbox-as-cube mix-up appeared again.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects, and sorting solids by flat and curved faces. Checking whether all faces are equal squares helped them correct the matchbox example once, but the same mix-up appeared again later. At home, compare a dice and a matchbox by counting and checking the shapes of their faces.
